modal.help_title: Faiga e galue ai le SuperSearch
modal.help_s1b: Ki Drives mo voluma atoa, + Faaopoopo faila e faaopoopo, aveese e x se tasi, poo le faapipii ala `;`-tuuesese i Faatonu. O le fesuiaiga o laupepa e sui ai faila.
modal.help_s2b: Igoa, Regex (upu Rust), Faasee, Anotusi faila, Glob (*.rs), Soo se (OR) / Leai se (NOT), tetele (byte poo 10M/1G), aso (YYYY-MM-DD), lisi faasee Le aofia, Faaiuga poo faailoga vaega (sui, toe kiliki e faamama; e teuteu e Pulea mea masani), Le amanaia mataitusi, Faaali natia.
modal.help_s3b: Faamau tele Suesue ma saili poo Enter. E toe fai e Toe faafou ma taofia le filifiliga. E otometi Live teuteuga (pepe i le amataga). E le faia sailiga gaogao — tuu le * i Glob mo mea uma.
modal.help_s4b: E faatono ulutala laiti, e alu Alu i itulau, e fafaga pusa siaki i Kopi ala / Siitia / Tape ma auina atu CSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF. E toe faafoi mai e sailiga ua teu ma ata Talu ai nei faamama uma e aofia ai faila, OR/NOT, ma natia.
modal.help_keys_body: E saili Enter · e tuu e Esc le taulaiga / tapuni talanoaga · e alu ↑/↓ le filifiliga · e faailoga e Space le laina · e alu Tab i le va o pule.
